brief.seam: Call the real documents.read_document through its public interface
brief.input_description: filename 'document.txt' inside the allowed root. Setup: Create tmp_path/allowed/ holding document.txt with the content 'quarterly report', and tmp_path/outside.txt, outside allowed/, with the content 'outside secret'
brief.property_to_assert: Returns exactly 'quarterly report', the content of allowed/document.txt

source_files.content:
from pathlib import Path

import documents


def test_reads_existing_document(tmp_path: Path):
    (tmp_path / "note.txt").write_text("hello")
    assert documents.read_document(tmp_path, "note.txt") == "hello"
